equation_summary: YOCO has two decoders. Self-decoder = Simple-GLA: S_t = exp(g_t) * S_{t-1} + k_t^T v_t (head-scalar data-dependent log-sigmoid gate gk, after-update read o_i = q_i^T S_i, scale 1/sqrt(K)); see naive_recurrent_simple_gla lines 83-91. Cross-decoder = softmax attention (parallel_attn) of per-token query q_i against a SHARED KV cache built once by YOCOSharedKVBuilder from a source hidden state (kv_norm then k/v projections), with interleaved RoPE on both paths. The composition crosses two families: U2.A state for the self-decoder, U1.S over the shared-KV cache for the cross-decoder.
state_shape: self-decoder [B,H,K,V] matrix recurrent state; cross-decoder shared [B,S,H_kv,D] KV cache
normalization: none (softmax only in the U1.S cross-decoder)
ledger_verdicts: CONFIRM ledger graph E[RoPE/gates/projections]; U2.A(Simple-GLA self-decoder); E[shared KV/cache construction]; U1.S(cross-decoder); E[output] matches yoco.py: YOCOGatedRetention (chunk_simple_gla) + YOCOSharedKVBuilder + YOCOCrossAttention (parallel_attn)
CONFIRM blocker 'Both state/cache regimes and layer order; no Simple-GLA fragment as YOCO claim' is correct and necessary

MISSING-BLOCKER the U2.A self-decoder additionally has the common prerequisite B[K2_graph_execution] (no U2 call binds end to end yet); the row must also inherit the Simple-GLA gate VJP / low-precision chunk concerns of arch-018
direction_justification: Both the Simple-GLA self-decoder (U2.A) and the shared-KV softmax cross-decoder (U1.S) are closed contracts, so the composition needs no new core semantics but is gated on the K2 graph binder for the self-decoder branch.
open_questions: Exact layer ordering (which layers are self- vs cross-decoder) comes from modeling_yoco.py, not yet audited here
Whether the shared-KV cache is built from one designated layer's hidden state and reused across all cross-decoder layers (official YOCO) needs modeling-file confirmation
